description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant situated on West Broadway, one of Vancouver's main east-west cycling corridors. The location offers the full Canadian McDonald's menu including burgers, McCafé beverages, and snacks available for takeout. As a large chain location on a busy urban street, it is a predictable and accessible stop for cyclists passing through the area.
